text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Nuclear power's lifecycle emissions per unit of electricity are comparable to wind and lower than solar.","cited_pids":["nuclear#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Nuclear power provides firm, weather-independent output that could reduce the storage a decarbonised grid would need.","cited_pids":["nuclear#1"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Countries with large existing nuclear fleets decarbonised their grids faster than comparable countries relying on renewables alone.","cited_pids":["nuclear#2"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Nuclear power's land use per unit of energy is far lower than that of wind or solar.","cited_pids":["nuclear#3"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Recent European and North American nuclear projects ran years late and well over budget.","cited_pids":["nuclear#4"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"New nuclear reactors often take a decade or more to build, so they may not cut emissions within near-term climate windows.","cited_pids":["nuclear#5"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"No country has commissioned a permanent high-level nuclear waste repository at scale.","cited_pids":["nuclear#6"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Cost overruns have pushed several utilities into severe financial distress.","cited_pids":["nuclear#7"]}]}
